breaking_news.headline: Trade tariffs cause whiplash at Port Milwaukee
breaking_news.summary: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

breaking_news.headline: Netflix lays off 6% of workforce amidst slowing growth
breaking_news.summary: Netflix is regrouping after the release of its latest quarterly earnings this week. Revenue growth at the streaming giant has slowed as the company works to overhaul its programming unit.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
breaking_news.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

breaking_news.headline: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

breaking_news.headline: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
breaking_news.summary: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.

breaking_news.headline: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
breaking_news.summary: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

breaking_news.headline: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
breaking_news.summary: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

breaking_news.headline: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged  — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

breaking_news.headline: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
breaking_news.summary: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.

breaking_news.headline: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
breaking_news.summary: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

breaking_news.headline: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
breaking_news.summary: No official reason has been given for postponing next month’s hearing to May 2027, the family says.

breaking_news.headline: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
breaking_news.summary: The energy minister described it as a "major milestone" for the East African nation.

breaking_news.headline: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
breaking_news.summary: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

breaking_news.headline: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
breaking_news.summary: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and is working with passengers on "temporary living arrangements".

breaking_news.headline: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
breaking_news.summary: With 85% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.

breaking_news.headline: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
breaking_news.summary: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

breaking_news.headline: Healey tells departments to make 1% cuts to fund defence
breaking_news.summary: The reduction in public spending will go towards paying for the Defence Investment Plan.

breaking_news.headline: Budget 2026: Key points at a glance
breaking_news.summary: Here’s what you need to know from John Healey’s first Budget, as the chancellor sets out the government’s tax and spending plans.

breaking_news.headline: Tax thresholds remain unchanged - here's what it means for your pay
breaking_news.summary: The point at which you start to pay tax, and the point where you tip into paying a higher rate of tax have been frozen for three more years.

breaking_news.headline: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
breaking_news.summary: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.
